nodes.summary: Batched serving throughput under sixteen concurrent requests, as evaluated by the vLLM-MLX continuous-batching source. Prompt lengths, output lengths, and scheduler settings are not fully recoverable from the report.
nodes.title: Sixteen concurrent generation requests

nodes.summary: The public 64-token iterate and longer local-submit paths used for correctness gating. Exact tokens, reference rows, cache offsets, and rollback are checked here, but its timing is directional only and cannot promote anything.
nodes.title: Public local iterate and submit decode path

nodes.summary: The official scored workload: eight prompt pairs, a fixed 512-token seed followed by a 512-token scored decode window, hidden prompt distribution, and a median-based decode-speedup score with a per-pair exact-token and ordered-top-two fidelity gate. All eight pairs must report parity_all_ok before a score is issued.
nodes.title: Ranked MTP decode over eight hidden prompt pairs

nodes.summary: A very short local wall-time workload: load the model in a fresh process and emit six greedy tokens. It measures load plus first-tokens cost, not steady-state decode, and no quality artifact covers output beyond the six-token window.
nodes.title: Separate-process load plus six greedy tokens
